components.name: CardDealer
components.doc: A deck and a table. Dealing sends each card from the deck to its position along an arc, lifting and turning face up on the way, one after another. Shuffle riffles the deck into a new random order and Reset restores the factory order. With five positions the finished hand is named like a poker hand.

components.name: CardDealerPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: a five card table.

members.name: positions
members.doc: How many positions the table has, from 1 to 7. Five makes a poker hand, and the hand gets named.

members.name: onDeal
members.doc: Called after every deal with the cards now on the table, in position order.

members.name: dealOnMount
members.doc: Deal a full hand once the table has been measured, so a preview opens with cards on the table.
